entities.summary: Demola Aladekomo KJW HOA is a Nigerian computer engineer and businessman. He is the chairman of SmartCity Resorts Plc, Card Centre Nigeria Limited, Treasure-nest Limited, Crops Nigeria Limited, Chams Consortium Limited, and Insider Concepts Limited. He is also the founder of Chams Plc.
